title: Medical Medium - Secrets Behind Chronic and Mystery Illness and How to Finally Heal
text: [Music] in this book I reveal truths about chronic illnesses you won't learn anywhere else you won't hear it from your doctor read it in any other books or find it on the internet these are secrets that have not yet surfaced about how to finally heal and I'm bringing them to light to you for the very first time when I was 4 years old I Heard a Voice I am the spirit of the most high there is none above me but God himself that night at the dinner table Spirit came to me but you know I liked [Music] it I'm sorry his mouth never moved but I could hear his voice speak to me I here for you I'm not a doctor I have no medical training but I can tell you things about your health that no one else can I can give you Clarity on diseases that doctors often misdiagnose or treat incorrectly or they just give up on and label mystery [Music] illness stop making excuses I used to everybody always makes brownies they always have so much of that stuff say lung cancer lung cancer where it die I didn't even know what those words meant say it again say l lung now say cancer cancer now say grandma has lung cancer grandma has been cancer are you okay huh my grandmother visited her doctor and the chest x-ray revealed she had lung cancer for over 20 years I've helped tens of thousands of people recover and heal from illnesses such as rheumatoid arthritis fibromyalgia chronic te syndrome lime disease and so much more it's time for you to learn these secrets and gain control over your life it's the way it's meant to be it's the way Spirit wanted it to be [Music]
